name: API Tester
description: Complete REST API testing tool similar to Postman. Test APIs, switch roles, generate code snippets, and visualize responses.
project_description: API Tester embeds a Postman-style REST client directly into the Drupal admin UI (Configuration » Development » API Tester). From a single-page interface it builds and sends arbitrary HTTP requests (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS) with custom query params, headers, JSON/XML/text/form bodies, and one of several auth strategies (Bearer, Basic, API key, or the live Drupal session with an injected X-CSRF-Token). Requests are proxied server-side through a Drupal controller and Guzzle, so responses come back with status, timing, size, headers and a syntax-highlighted / tree / preview body view. A "Test as User" setting re-runs the request under another site account to verify permission and access-control logic, and requests can be saved as per-user presets (stored in the State API) and exported as ready-to-run code snippets for 13+ languages. The module ships no third-party dependencies beyond Drupal core and Guzzle, provides two permissions (use / administer api tester), and stores no configuration entities.
